This '''sentient species''' was native to a [[Unidentified dead red moon|dead red moon]] orbiting the [[Unidentified planet (dead red moon)|third]] planet in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]]. They had been extinct for millennia before their homeworld was visited again by [[Rezi Soresh]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. They built underground tunnels, lasting long after their extinction, which Soresh would use during his time on the moon.
